home.noProjects: No projects yet. A project is just a folder omp works in.
home.pickProject: Pick a project on the left, or start a new one.

missing.title: Can't find “{{name}}”
missing.body: The folder {{path}} was moved or deleted. Point to where it is now, or remove it from the list.

recent.title: Recent chats
recent.empty: Nothing here yet — start a chat and it will show up in this list.

health.title: Project health
health.noUpstream: Only on this computer — not on GitHub yet
health.noGit: Not a git project yet. Git keeps a history of your changes so you can always go back.

fix.label: Fix a bug
fix.text: Something on my site is broken — the checkout total is wrong when I apply a coupon. Find out why and fix it.

build.label: Build a feature
build.text: Build a simple contact page for this project with a form that checks the email looks right.

explain.label: Explain this
explain.text: Explain what this project does and how its main parts fit together, in plain language.

cleanup.label: Clean up
cleanup.text: Clean up this folder: find unused files and duplicated code, and tell me before deleting anything.

tests.label: Add tests
tests.text: Write tests for the login flow and run them until they pass.

mobile.label: Fix mobile layout
mobile.text: Make this page look better on phones — keep the design, fix the layout.

empty.title: Empty folder
empty.body: Start fresh in a new folder

existing.title: Open existing
existing.body: Use a folder already on this computer

clone.title: Clone from GitHub
clone.body: Download a project from a GitHub link

empty.description: Name the new folder and choose where it goes.

existing.description: Pick the folder omp should work in.

clone.description: Paste the project's link. omp downloads a copy to this computer.

location.label: Location
location.picker: Choose where to put the project

existing.already: This folder is already a project — opening it instead

problem.invalid: That doesn't look like a project link. Try something like github.com/owner/repo.
problem.notFound: Couldn't find {{label}}. Check the link — if the project is private, sign in to GitHub first.
problem.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and the link.

problem.reserved: That name is reserved by the computer. Pick another one.
problem.trailingDotOrSpace: Names can't end with a dot or a space.
problem.notDirectory: A file with that name is already there.
problem.notEmpty: A folder with that name already exists and has files in it.

firstChat.description: You can start working right away.
firstChat.hint: omp starts on this as soon as the project is ready.
firstChat.placeholder: Explain what this project does, in plain language.

discard.title: Discard this project?
discard.body: What you've filled in so far won't be kept.
discard.bodyBusy: The partly downloaded folder will be removed.

instructions.title: Project instructions
instructions.subtitle: What omp should know about {{name}}
instructions.explainer: omp reads this file at the start of every chat in this project. Describe how the project works, commands to run, and things to avoid.
instructions.shadowed: omp reads {{active}} instead of this file, because it comes first. Edit {{active}}, or empty it to use this one.
instructions.stickyNote: Sticky rules: omp keeps these in mind on every single step, not just at the start.
instructions.placeholder:
# About this project

- How to run it: …
- Please don't change: …

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.body: Your edits to the instructions haven't been saved.

rules.explainer: Rules are short notes omp follows only when they matter — for example, only when it touches certain files.
rules.emptyBody: Add a rule to teach omp something about part of this project.
rules.frontmatterError: The header of this file has a problem: {{error}}
rules.deleteBody: This removes the rule file from the project. This can't be undone.
rules.name: Name
rules.nameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
rules.nameInvalid: Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
rules.nameTaken: A rule with this name already exists.
rules.descriptionHint: One sentence, e.g. “When changing the checkout page”.
rules.alwaysHint: Otherwise omp decides when it's relevant.
rules.bodyPlaceholder:
- Keep prices in cents
- Run the tests after changing the cart

model.title: Model
model.body: The AI model new chats in this project start with.
model.projectOnly: Only this project uses this model.
model.usingGlobal: Following your setting for all projects.

mode.title: Permission mode

always-ask.label: Ask me first
always-ask.body: omp can look around on its own, but asks before it changes a file or runs a command.

write.label: Edits OK
write.body: omp can read and edit files on its own, but asks before running commands or starting helpers.

yolo.label: Auto
yolo.body: omp works on its own without asking. Only use this in projects you trust.

mode.projectOnly: Only this project uses this mode.
mode.usingGlobal: Following your setting for all projects.
mode.autoWarning: Auto lets omp run commands without asking. Only use it in projects you trust.

more.title: Tools and helpers
more.mcpBody: Outside tools omp can use in this project, like a database or ticket tracker.
more.agentsBody: Specialists only this project uses, like a reviewer or an explorer.
more.instructionsBody: Notes omp reads at the start of every chat here.

remove.title: Remove from list
remove.body: Hides the project here. The folder and its files stay on your computer.
remove.confirmBody: The folder and its files stay on your computer. Chats saved in it still show up until you archive them.

import.title: Import a chat
import.body: Bring a conversation from another AI coding tool into omp and keep going where it left off.
import.note: omp opens its own list so you can pick the conversation. The chat continues in the folder it came from.
import.failed: Couldn't look for conversations to import

share.title: Share this chat
share.noChat: Open a chat to share it.
share.needsMessage: Send a message first so there's something to share.

link.explainer: Creates an encrypted link — only people with it can read the chat.
link.gistToggle: Save it as a secret GitHub gist
link.gistHint: Uses your GitHub account instead of omp's share server.
link.truncated: Some very long parts were shortened to fit.

file.explainer: Save this chat as a web page you can open anywhere.

invite.explainer: Let someone watch or join this chat live
invite.notLive: Start the chat first — send a message or wait until omp is ready.
invite.endedRestart: Sharing stopped because the chat restarted. Start it again to get new links.
invite.privacy: People join in their browser through omp's public relay (my.omp.sh). Everything is encrypted end to end — the relay can't read it.
invite.controlHint: Can type messages and answer omp's questions.
invite.nobody: Send someone a link. People appear here when they join.
